assumptions.statement: The overall design polygon is maintainer-defined provisional geometry, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All derived geometry and metric values are temporary and must be replaced/recomputed when an official or cleared polygon is obtained.

assumptions.statement: All three key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles.
assumptions.impact: They support intake discussion only and cannot support parcel, ownership, engineering or statutory detailed design.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 does not cover the taskbook's Dazhongsi Station four-quadrant focus.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi outputs are limited to portable principles, scenarios and metrics until the polygon is replaced.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, parcel/ownership, heritage/green/blue lines, road redlines, utilities, fire, flood, geotechnical and engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setback, retain/renovate/demolish, bridge/tunnel and capacity conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: OSM extraction is incomplete public mapping and not an official existing-condition survey.
assumptions.impact: Counts and lengths support relative context only; absence from OSM is not a service deficit.

assumptions.statement: The 2025-05-28 Sentinel-2 L2A scene has 10 m pixels and represents one acquisition date.
assumptions.impact: True-color and NDVI support broad vegetation/water/rail/impervious context and field-verification priority only; they do not establish ownership, legal boundaries, fine-grained public-space quality, human activity or health effects.

assumptions.statement: The three building features are field-station program envelopes, not surveyed or proposed building footprints.
assumptions.impact: No building, height, structure, ownership or demolition claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Route geometry represents experience/audit corridors, not road or bridge/tunnel alignments.
assumptions.impact: Transport engineering, signal and redline design require professional data and approvals.

assumptions.statement: UrbanComp health findings are mostly observational and context-dependent.
assumptions.impact: They generate testable public-space hypotheses, not diagnosis, treatment or causal claims.

assumptions.statement: AI outputs are advisory; deterministic GIS and authorized humans retain responsibility.
assumptions.impact: No model may make rights, health, eligibility, procurement, planning or enforcement decisions automatically.
